questions.question:
A positively charged particle is projected with uniform velocity along the axis of a current carrying 
long solenoid. Which one of the following statements is true?
options: The particle will be accelerated along the axis.
The particle will follow a circular path.
The particle will move with same velocity along the axis.
The particle will follow a parabolic path.
